sensor_metric_semantics.scale: Nominal ADC conversion, not calibrated signed analogue voltage.
sensor_metric_semantics.other_firmware: Do not apply these assignments to EE5/EF5 without separately verifying their implementation.
sensor_metric_semantics.historical_reports: Earlier derived RMS labels referring to rms_mean describe arithmetic mean. Numerical raw readings are unchanged.

operator_audio: Plant EC5 alone audible in repetitions 1 and 2, silent in 3. Adding black EB5 audible in all three, reported more notes especially first two; silence after release marked yes.

data_quality.meaning: Flags missing host-received telemetry, including phase boundaries; does not prove a node reboot or missing analogue response.

findings: EC5 produces 5 and 14 NoteOns during first two plant-only windows, zero in the third; planted contact is not consistently detected.
Adding black EB5 produces NoteOns in all five nodes in each repetition with EC5 settled ADC RMS median zero.
First two scheduled release windows contain approximately 17.04 and 10.48 seconds of held MIDI in EC5, third approximately 3.14; recovered silence is delayed or intermittent in the first two.
limits: MIDI after release cue is not exact human release latency or measured audio duration.
Differences between sequential contact orders and black electrodes remain confounded by baseline drift.
EE5/EF5 will be measured standing; do not infer a posture effect by comparing different plants or firmware.
